title: A Night Away — the Missing Keeper

nodes.title: The Bell Beneath the Water
nodes.text: At midnight, a bell rings from the submerged chapel. By morning the lighthouse keeper has vanished. His daughter Mira waits at the harbor.
nodes.secret: The bell responds to a ritual being performed in the old saltworks.

nodes.title: The Silent Fish Market
nodes.text: The fishers sell their catch in complete silence. Someone has bought every sack of salt.
nodes.secret: A vendor saw carts heading toward the saltworks.

nodes.title: The Old Saltworks
nodes.text: Cart tracks end at a barred gate. A green light burns inside.
nodes.secret: The lighthouse keeper is alive. He is trying to stop the ritual he started.

nodes.title: Mira, the Keeper’s Daughter
nodes.text: She wants her father back. She knows a way into the saltworks through the drainage channel.
nodes.secret: She hid her father’s journal because she fears he will be blamed.

nodes.title: Salt Silences the Bell
nodes.text: The keeper’s notes and old songs suggest that a circle of salt can interrupt the ritual.
nodes.secret: Destroying the bell will release what lies beneath the chapel.

nodes.title: The Submerged Chapel
nodes.text: At low tide, steps emerge from the water. Fresh protective marks cover the stones.
nodes.secret: The chapel is a seal, not the creature’s home.
